provider.name: Barcode of Life Data Systems
provider.organization_type: DNA barcode specimen, sequence, taxonomy, image, project, dataset, and identification platform
provider.description: Barcode of Life Data Systems is a global informatics platform for DNA barcode records, specimen and voucher metadata, sequences, trace files, images, taxonomic assignments, Barcode Index Numbers, public datasets, projects, and sequence identification.
institutional_context: University of Guelph and collaborating biodiversity institutions

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting BOLD Systems documentation, DNA barcode record definitions, BIN guidance, APIs, identification services, submission standards, downloads, legal terms, citation instructions, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: BOLD Systems and its supporting institutions remain authoritative for barcode records, BIN assignments, identifiers, project and dataset metadata, APIs, downloads, citation, rights, legal terms, and contact information.

notes: Verify current production API paths across legacy and version 4 portals.
Do not infer undocumented endpoints from browser traffic alone.
Capture endpoint families, request parameters, authentication, pagination, limits, response schemas, examples, and legal conditions.
Record any differences between public APIs, authenticated project APIs, identification services, and bulk download services.
Capture exact official legal wording before normalizing rights metadata.
Separate BOLD platform terms from record-, sequence-, trace-, image-, project-, and dataset-level rights.
Preserve dataset DOI citations and contributor attribution requirements.
Do not expose private, embargoed, or authenticated project data through a public Speciedex build.
Do not assume source-code licensing applies to BOLD records, sequences, images, or datasets.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Legacy and version 4 BOLD paths may redirect, coexist, or expose different documentation; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every specimen, BIN, taxon, image, project, or dataset page when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store API keys, passwords, cookies, OAuth tokens, project credentials, or session credentials in this JSON file.
Never import private, embargoed, restricted, or authenticated project data into public Speciedex outputs.
BOLD platform content, specimen records, sequences, traces, images, BINs, projects, datasets, and source code may carry different rights.
